notes: DISCOVERED during the construction-spending-2026-10-01 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). It reads the SAME August 2026 reference month as the proposing print, from the new-home demand side, seven days ahead of it — the exact spacing at which construction-spending-2026-11-02 proposed new-home-sales-2026-10-27 against its own reference month, one cycle later. The series' September edition is untracked: new-home-sales-2026-11-25 and -12-23 are canonical and 10-27 exists only as a proposal, so the demand leg of the August reference month has no entry. Unlike the housing-starts sibling proposed in the same PR, this one is NOT a GDPNow trigger and draws no posted vintage on 09-24 — that asymmetry is itself the reason to track both: the corridor otherwise carries the residential supply side and not the demand side. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the same measured grounds as the sibling Census entries — no macro-keyed house playbook (re-grepped 2026-09-06 across trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md, 0 hits) and no instrument attaches — and whoever researches it should re-derive both rather than inherit them.
